name_es: Transformación geodésica Lat/Lon -> UTM (EPSG:32718 para Perú)
purpose: Convertir coordenadas geográficas (lat, lon) a UTM (easting, northing) usando serie de Krüger basada en elipsoide WGS84
equations_ascii: N = a / sqrt(1 - e2 * sin(lat_rad)^2)  # radius of curvature

unit_equations.name: M_arc
unit_equations.value: m = m * radian - m * dimensionless * radian

numerical_method: Krüger series (6th order) for UTM transformation per ISO 19111
validity_limits: lon must be within +/- 3 degrees of central meridian for the UTM zone
acceptance_rules: easting_m in [166000, 834000] for Peru UTM zones
reverse transformation (UTM->Lat/Lon) must reproduce input within 1 mm
computed easting must lie within 500000 +/- 334000 (UTM zone width)
failure_modes: input latitude or longitude is None

name_es: Área y perímetro de polígono por fórmula del zapato (shoelace)
purpose: Calcular área y perímetro de un polígono cerrado definido por vértices (e.g., límite de terreno)
equations_ascii: n = length(vertices)  # number of vertices (polygon must be closed: v[0] == v[n-1])

unit_equations.name: area
unit_equations.value: m2 = m * m (sum of cross products)

validity_limits: vertices in counter-clockwise or clockwise order
acceptance_rules: computed_area within 1% of PRJ_071 declared value

name_es: Pendiente y azimuth entre dos puntos topográficos
purpose: Calcular la pendiente porcentual y el azimuth entre dos puntos para acceso, caminos y ruteo
equations_ascii: azimuth_deg = atan2(dx, dy) * 180 / pi  # degrees from North, clockwise
equations_latex: \Delta x = x_2 - x_1, \quad \Delta y = y_2 - y_1, \quad \Delta z = z_2 - z_1
acceptance_rules: for road design: slope_pct <= 12 (per RNE NTE-110)

name_es: Carga sísmica base shear según NTE-060 (RNE Perú)
purpose: Calcular la fuerza cortante basal sísmica para estructuras según el reglamento peruano NTE-060
equations_ascii: R = reduction factor (concrete special=8, intermediate=6, steel special=9, masonry=3)
W = total seismic weight of structure (kN)
V_base_shear = (Z * U * S * W) / R  # kN

variables.name: total_weight_W
variables.origin: PRJ_120 total_installed_capacity_mw (used as proxy for plant weight)

unit_equations.name: base_shear
unit_equations.value: kN = dimensionless * dimensionless * dimensionless * kN / dimensionless

validity_limits: R per structural type per NTE-060 Table 6.1
acceptance_rules: base_shear_kn < 0.5 * W (typical upper bound for seismic)
Z, S, U, R within NTE-060 tabulated ranges
failure_modes: Z outside [0.10, 0.45] indicates wrong seismic zone
R factor inconsistent with structure type
soil type not classified per NTE-060

name_es: Capacidad de carga admisible del suelo (Meyerhof)
purpose: Calcular la capacidad de carga última y admisible de una cimentación superficial usando Meyerhof
equations_ascii: q_ultimate = c * Nc + gamma * D * Nq + 0.5 * gamma * B * Ngamma  # kPa
FS = 3.0  # factor of safety for permanent structures
equations_latex: q_u = cN_c + \gamma D N_q + 0.5\gamma B N_\gamma

unit_equations.name: bearing_capacity
unit_equations.value: kPa = kPa * dimensionless + kN/m3 * m * dimensionless + kN/m3 * m * dimensionless

acceptance_rules: computed q_allowable matches geotechnical report within 10%
phi consistent with soil type per USCS
failure_modes: phi > 45 indicates gravel/cemented soil (Meyerhof not applicable)
groundwater above foundation base (effective stress analysis needed)
D > B indicates deep foundation (use pile capacity instead)

name_es: Estadísticas metocean (Hs, Tp, viento) con percentiles
purpose: Calcular media, varianza, percentiles 50/95/99 y valores extremos de variables metocean para diseño offshore/flotante
equations_ascii: variance = sum((x_i - mean)^2 for i in range(n)) / (n - 1)  # sample variance
# Extreme value analysis (Gumbel for annual maxima)
# Fit mu, beta via method of moments:
equations_latex: P_p = x_{\lfloor p(n-1)+1\rfloor} + (p(n-1)+1 - \lfloor p(n-1)+1\rfloor)(x_{\lceil p(n-1)+1\rceil} - x_{\lfloor p(n-1)+1\rfloor})
numerical_method: Linear interpolation for percentiles (ISO 16269-4), Gumbel method of moments for extremes
validity_limits: n >= 10 years for extreme value analysis (annual maxima)
no NaN or infinite values in dataset
failure_modes: non-normal distribution (use Weibull or GEV instead)

name_es: Capacidad de cortocircuito en PCC según IEC 60909
purpose: Calcular la corriente de cortocircuito trifásica simétrica en el punto de común acoplamiento (PCC) según IEC 60909-0
equations_ascii: c_factor = 1.1  # voltage factor for max short-circuit current
acceptance_rules: I_k3 < device_interrupt_rating (e.g., 25 kA for typical MV switchgear)
i_p < device_peak_rating (e.g., 65 kA for typical MV switchgear)

purpose: Determinar la potencia nominal del transformador a partir de la carga, factor de potencia y factor de de-rating
equations_ascii: S_selected = min(s for s in standard_sizes if s >= S_rated)
numerical_method: Direct sizing, snap-up to standard size
failure_modes: no standard size >= S_rated (S_rated exceeds maximum)

name_es: Resistencia de puesta a tierra según IEEE Std 80-2013
purpose: Calcular la resistencia de la malla de puesta a tierra usando la fórmula simplificada de IEEE Std 80 para grid rectangular
equations_ascii: # IEEE 80-2013 simplified formula for grid resistance:
L_total = total_conductor_length_m  # m (includes grid conductors + ground rods)
# For rectangular grid with buried depth h:
R_g = rho * (1/A_grid^0.5 + 1/(L_total + 1.15 * h * A_grid^0.5) + 1/(L_total * sqrt(A_grid)))  # ohm

variables.name: soil_resistivity
variables.origin: derived from PRJ_092 friction_angle and PRJ_096 groundwater_depth_m

acceptance_rules: R_g < 1 ohm for HV substations (>50 kV)
failure_modes: rho > 5000 ohm-m (rocky soil, deep-driven rods needed)
A_grid too small for required R_g
active fault within 5 km (high seismic risk affects ground grid)

name_es: Demanda de agua contra incendios según NFPA 13/20
purpose: Calcular el caudal de agua contra incendios y el volumen de reserva basado en la clase de riesgo y el área de diseño
equations_ascii: # NFPA 13 design density based on hazard class:
design_density_mm_min = 8.2 if hazard_class == 'ordinary_hazard_1' else 12.2 if 'ordinary_hazard_2' else 4.1 if 'light' else 8.2
design_area_m2 = max(140, total_protected_area_m2 * 0.15) if hazard_class starts with 'ordinary' else max(140, total_protected_area_m2 * 0.1)
duration_min = 60 if hazard_class == 'light' else 90 if 'ordinary' else 120 if 'extra' else 60
H_pump = 50  # m head (typical for sprinkler system)
numerical_method: Direct per NFPA 13 hazard class tables
validity_limits: design_area in [140, 465] m2 per NFPA 13 hazard class
eta_pump in [0.6, 0.85] for centrifugal fire pumps
acceptance_rules: P_pump matches standard pump size (50, 75, 100, 150, 200 kW)
sprinkler spacing <= 12 m2/sprinkler for ordinary hazard
failure_modes: no water source capable of supplying Q_demand

name_es: Capacidad de arquitectura SCADA y comunicaciones
purpose: Dimensionar la capacidad de comunicaciones SCADA y el número de RTUs requeridos para cubrir todos los puntos de medición/control de la planta
equations_ascii: # Count RTUs based on plant size and SCADA architecture:
numerical_method: Direct sizing per IEC 60870-5-104 bandwidth model
validity_limits: poll_cycle in [0.5, 5] s for fast SCADA
acceptance_rules: redundancy matches criticality (control room location REMOTE_BOTH requires redundancy >= 2)
failure_modes: no redundancy for REMOTE_BOTH control room
